case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No(s). 28410-28414 of 2023)

parties.respondent: State of Madhya Pradesh AND OTHERS ETC.

summary: Land acquisition jurisdiction: objections under Section 15 of LARR Act 2013 must be heard by Collector personally; delegation to SDO invalid; analogous to Section 5-A of Land Acquisition Act 1894; High Court erred in dismissing writ petitions as infructuous after final award; writs to quash acquisition proceedings allowed; acquisition proceedings set aside for non-compliance with mandatory procedure.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.3(e)
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.3(g)
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.11
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.15
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.19
Om Prakash v. State of U.P.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment quashed; land acquisition proceedings set aside; Collector to personally hear objections under Section 15 and proceed afresh.
